A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ST-BCP study despite the changed title. All 26 pages in each version, including Appendices A–I, support comparison of the text, equations, tables, figures and proofs.

before.justification: v2 reports original classification experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet in Section 4, with additional score-function, sensitivity and robustness results in Appendices A, C and E.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical experiments and their outcomes, including Tables 1–5 and Figures 1–5.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–3 retain the same symmetric score transformation, prediction-set construction and LOO estimation procedures. Appendix E's robust transformation and corrected coverage estimator were already present in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet classification under the same constant and adaptive size-constraint scenarios. No evaluated dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: BCP with the identity transformation remains the comparator in Tables 1–2 and Figures 1–3. Appendix E retains the same comparisons of the original transformation with the robust transformation and corrected coverage estimator.

E3.justification: The classifiers, calibration/test sampling, calibration sizes, score functions, size constraints and evaluation metrics are unchanged. Appendix C retains the baseline k = 20 and sensitivity settings k = 20, 21, 30 and 70.

E4.justification: The score-function analysis in Appendix A, calibration-size and architecture analyses in Figures 2–3, k sensitivity analyses in Tables 3–5, and robustness comparisons in Figures 4–5 are all retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Both versions report M = 500 independent random trials in Section 4.1 and retain the same standard-deviation calculations and estimator-distribution reporting. No seed information, confidence intervals or significance-testing procedures are added or removed.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 and Figures 1–5 retain their results. For example, Table 1 reports GAP values of 5.38% for BCP and 0.72% for ST-BCP under the same CIFAR-10, ResNet50, T = 2, n = 200 setting in both versions. Table 2's APS GAP values remain 48.2% and 0.84%.

T1.justification: Section 3.2 rewrites Equation 17, its decomposition and the objective using complementary miscoverage probabilities, preserving their mathematical meaning. It also corrects the apparent prediction-set argument typo from h to X_{n+1}. These are notation edits; the substantive assumptions, theorems and appendix derivations and proofs are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the claims about exchangeability, LOO consistency, optimal transformation and its computable approximation, and reduced coverage gaps. The shortened title does not materially redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and limitations are retained, including Taylor-approximation caveats and recommendations for robust or corrected methods when T is small. Appendix E paragraphs shift across page breaks without changing their interpretations or applicability conditions.

D1.justification: Page 2 replaces the anonymous 4open.science code pointer with a link to the named Junxian-Liu1/ST-BCP GitHub repository. This updates the documented access location; implementation details, hyperparameters and processing instructions are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 5 and the complete bibliography retain the same cited works and positioning relative to BCP and conformal e-prediction. References reflow across pages 9–11 following the added acknowledgements.

P1.justification: v3 shortens the title, standardizes several headings and capitalization choices, adds acknowledgements, and removes the impact statement's section number. Minor notation and punctuation edits accompany these changes; the main narrative and appendix organization remain stable.

P2.justification: Updated running headers, a conference publication footer, equation spacing and acknowledgements produce limited layout changes and text reflow. Tables 1–5, Figures 1–5 and the Appendix I graph retain their content and designs.

improvement.justification: v3 offers a small clarity gain by correcting the prediction-set argument in Section 3.2 and expressing the gap consistently in miscoverage terms. The other edits update code-access information and presentation. Experiments, substantive theory and limitations are preserved, so the overall improvement is limited.
